impact: preflight-disk FAILED at 90% used / 51G free, blocking the full gate. scripts/reclaim.sh --apply could reclaim only 1009KB: every other target dir and worktree on the box was live under a concurrent agent. Root cause was self-inflicted in part -- this cycle had opened a SECOND CARGO_TARGET_DIR for apps/desktop/src-tauri (~20G) when verify.sh sets no CARGO_TARGET_DIR of its own and builds both crates into the one it inherits.
resolution: deleted the redundant desktop-only target dir (rm -rf), then proceeded with the documented override PREFLIGHT_DISK_MAX_PERCENT=93 -- the free-GB floor (20G) was never breached, 42-53G free throughout; the percentage floor is calibrated for a smaller disk than this 484G one
